title: Завдання та план оцифрування
fields_and_relations: План revision, частини/порядок, профіль, ризики й readiness.
required_interaction: Ready/postpone; змінений план не підмінює план старого capture/QC.

implementation.view_model: Digitization work list with derived stages, search, contextual actions, draft wizards and QC modal; versioned plan and pinned capture history
limitations: One expected file per plan line; advanced technical profiles remain pending.
implementation.state_storage: Shared normalized browser store, fixture version 3; incremental migration preserves prior user changes
permissions: media.write / physical.write / intake.send / intake.receive / legacy.write / legacy.review / capture.field, explicit archive grants
implementation.atomicity: Authorize and compare expected revision/package state; mutate clone; validate FK/type/version/hash; commit atomically.
